verdict.rationale: The evidence shows bulk-style operations in several indirect forms. The CLI can control multiple services and automate them through scripts, CloudFormation provisions or deletes all resources in a stack in one action, and Resource Groups organize many resources by tags or stack membership. None of this documents a dedicated batch or bulk-action capability, so bulk work relies on scripting or stack-level grouping. Missing for 10: explicit batch APIs or bulk-action commands across many items, documentation of acting on a Resource Group as a unit, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
